  tagline = 'Not your typical superhero story. A noir-drenched thriller about trauma, survival, and taking back control.',

When she discovers he has returned, Jessica must confront her past to protect those around her in this dark, psychological thriller.',

  episodeCount = 13,

  platform = 'Netflix',
  rtCriticsScore = 83,
  rtAudienceScore = 84,
  verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## Jessica Jones Cards: The Noir Collector''s Corner

Jessica Jones cards occupy a fascinating niche in Marvel collecting. The **2018 Upper Deck Marvel Masterpieces** set features stunning Jessica Jones artwork that commands premium prices. Netflix show cards from **2018 Upper Deck Marvel Defenders** are increasingly scarce as the Netflix era becomes a closed chapter. David Tennant as Kilgrave cards are particularly sought after given the character''s iconic status as one of Marvel''s best TV villains.',
  keyCards = '- **2018 Upper Deck Defenders Jessica Jones Base Card** — Key card from the definitive Netflix heroes set, typically $5-15
- **2015 Upper Deck Marvel Vibranium Jessica Jones** — Early appearance in card form, $8-20
- **2018 Marvel Masterpieces Jessica Jones Sketch Card** — Original art pieces, $50-200+ depending on artist
- **2019 Upper Deck Marvel Premier Jessica Jones Auto** — Rare autograph cards from the set, $30-80',
  content = '## Hell''s Kitchen''s Hardest-Drinking PI

Jessica Jones shattered expectations of what a Marvel show could be. This wasn''t about saving the world — it was about surviving it. Krysten Ritter''s portrayal of a traumatized, whiskey-soaked private investigator dealing with PTSD from mind control created something unprecedented in the superhero genre.

## David Tennant''s Kilgrave: TV''s Scariest Villain

David Tennant''s Kilgrave remains one of the most terrifying villains in all of Marvel — not because of cosmic power, but because of intimate, personal horror. His ability to control anyone with a word made every scene electric with tension. The show used this power as a metaphor for abuse and control that resonated far beyond comic book fans.

## Legacy and Impact

Jessica Jones proved that Marvel could tell mature, character-driven stories. It tackled themes of consent, trauma, and recovery with nuance rarely seen in superhero media. The show''s influence can be felt in everything from Moon Knight''s exploration of mental health to She-Hulk''s examination of what it means to be a woman with power.

## Fun Facts

- Krysten Ritter did most of her own stunts, including the door-ripping scenes
- David Tennant was so committed to the role he stayed in character between takes
- The show was originally developed for ABC before moving to Netflix
- Luke Cage''s introduction here led directly to his own series
- The purple lighting used whenever Kilgrave appeared became an iconic visual motif',
  metaDescription = 'Jessica Jones Season 1 (2015) complete guide — cast breakdown, Kilgrave analysis, trading card market values, key cards to collect, and why this noir thriller changed Marvel TV forever.',
  keywords = 'jessica jones, netflix marvel, krysten ritter, david tennant, kilgrave, defenders, marvel cards, hell''s kitchen, marvel noir',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Jessica Jones cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Jessica Jones connected to the MCU?","answer":"Yes, Jessica Jones is officially MCU canon. Characters from the show have appeared in She-Hulk and Daredevil: Born Again, confirming the Netflix shows are part of the main MCU timeline."},{"question":"Do I need to watch Daredevil before Jessica Jones?","answer":"No, Jessica Jones Season 1 is completely standalone. While both are set in Hell''s Kitchen, the stories are independent until The Defenders crossover."},{"question":"Is Jessica Jones appropriate for younger viewers?","answer":"No, Jessica Jones is rated TV-MA and deals with mature themes including mind control as a metaphor for abuse, violence, and adult content. It is designed for adult audiences."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'jessica-jones-season-1-2015'
